consumers.reason: excluded: a replace directive points this consumer at a local path, so bumping the version would not change what it builds (VM-F-608)

steps: 1. the upstream fix lands in demo-org/platform-common (wave 1)
2. the owning repository publishes a TAG. With trigger=tag a merge is not enough: nothing propagates until the version exists for consumers to resolve
3. 3 consumers are bumped to the fixed version (wave 2)
NOTE: consumers are on 2 different versions ([v1.8.0 v1.6.2]), which may prevent a single-target wave — laggards need a larger jump and may not build
4. 1 excluded consumers need a person: a wave cannot advance them and they are waiting for a fix that has already shipped (VM-AD §6.1.4)
